name: Empire State Building
description: Empire State Building: A famous skyscraper located in New York City, USA, with a total of 102 floors. It is a landmark building in New York City. It was built in 1930 and took 410 days to complete. It can be described as a miracle in the history of architecture. The top floor of the Empire State Building has always been a favorite place for the literary and artistic circles. Classic movies such as "King Kong" and "Sleepless in Seattle" have been filmed here. Since 1994, the Empire State Building has become a traditional place for young people to hold weddings on the top floor and New Yorkers to celebrate Valentine's Day, with a very romantic atmosphere.
